description:
TÜV SÜD – A global leader in the field of testing, inspection, management system certification and product certification renowned for quality, integrity and technical excellence.

Established more than 150 years ago in Germany, TÜV SÜD is a leading global provider of technical services with more than 28,000 highly skilled employees across 1,000 offices worldwide. TÜV SÜD offers a wide range of testing & product certification, inspection, auditing & system certification, training and knowledge services. We are a premium quality, safety, and sustainability solutions provider.

Tasks

  • Development, configuration, and continuous enhancement of solutions based on One Identity Manager (OIM)
  • Technical support to ensure the stable operation of the OIM platform in a production environment
  • Analysis, implementation, and testing of requirements in the Identity & Access Management (IAM) domain
  • Development and customization of OIM scripts (VB.NET, C#); processes, workflows, and synchronizations; custom modules and reports
  • Support in 3rd-level support, including incident and problem management within OIM operations
  • Analysis and resolution of operational issues, including root cause analysis
  • Execution of releases, upgrades, and patches
  • Support in creating operational concepts (monitoring, logging, backup, disaster recovery)
  • Close collaboration with business departments, IT security, infrastructure, and connected systems (e.g. Active Directory, Entra ID, SAP, SAP BTP, MuleSoft)
  • Support during audits, compliance activities, and recertification processes

Qualifications

  • Completed degree in computer science or a comparable qualification with relevant professional experience
  • Several years of hands-on experience with One Identity Manager (development and/or operations)
  • Very good knowledge of: the OIM data model, processes, and synchronization framework; Very good knowledge of script and rule development (VB.NET, C#); Very good knowledge of SQL and Windows Server (analysis, performance, troubleshooting)
  • Experience in application operations (ITSM, incident, change & problem management)
  • Knowledge of Identity & Access Management concepts (RBAC, Segregation of Duties, recertification)
  • Structured and responsible working style with strong analytical skills
  • Very good German and English language skills

Nice to Have

  • Experience with domain or tenant migrations in IAM environments
  • Experience with compliance- and audit-driven requirements (SoD, recertifications)
  • Experience in automation and operation of large, business-critical IAM landscapes
  • Experience with authorization concepts in SAP S/4HANA
  • Experience with Active Directory and Entra ID
  • Knowledge of: OIM integration with HR source systems; APIs / interfaces; cloud identities

Work Area: Digital, IT, IT Security & Safety

Country/Region: Romania

Job Location: Bucharest

Working Model : Hybrid

Employment Type: Full time / regular

Company: TÜV SÜD Romania S.R.L.

Org Unit Code: IT-BSG

Requisition ID: 5245
